subject: Endurance test (#607)
reason: The change "Endurance test (#607)" modifies only Python test-infrastructure files (testing/integration/stability_runner.py, stability_test.py, utils.py), adding new index-type variants and text attributes to valkey-search's own stability/endurance test harness. No module source code is changed, so the compiled module's behaviour — commands, replies, indexing, replication, persistence — is identical on both builds. There is no runtime path for a fuzzer scenario to reach; this is a test/CI-only change that needs no scenario.
